tasks.title: LR-1 + LR-5: slice budget/paging & honest display in emitText
tasks.description: Rewrite emitText's range branch (L1303–1312) so the sliced content flows through the same §5.5 inline-vs-paged decision as a whole file, with the paged directive resuming in FILE coordinates, and clamp FileDetail.range/read line to the delivered range. subtasks.title: Run the §5.5 inline-vs-paged decision on the slice (LR-1)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Read plan/011_e473dac8178b/architecture/code_map.md §emitText first. The range branch at file-injector.ts L1303–1312 pushes the slice whole unconditionally (comment L1304: 'Closed ranges are intentional extracts…'). The whole-file decision to reuse verbatim is L1315–1347: constants PAGED_THRESHOLD=0.6 (L88), HEAD_CHARS=8192 (L90); helpers headSlice(), headCompleteLineCount() (~L393), formatPagedDirectiveBlock(abs, len, startLine, injectedLines) (L411–412 — directive text already embeds 'offset:<startLine>, limit:2000'), extractDirectiveInner(). No notify/ctx is needed for LR-1 (state.paged already feeds the existing 'N whole, M paged' handler notify at L1700).
2. INPUT: emitText(abs, content, state, startLine?, endLine?) receives the FULL decoded content (markdown path injectMarkdown L1412 passes full content + range and emitText re-slices at L1305 via sliceLines, L183–189). state.remaining is number|null (null = O-1 fallback → never page).
3. LOGIC: In the range branch, compute slice = sliceLines(content, startLine, endLine ?? startLine); fileCost = Math.ceil(slice.length/4). Decision identical to whole-file: if state.remaining === null || fileCost <= PAGED_THRESHOLD * state.remaining → inject slice whole (kind:'text', subtract(fileCost)); else if slice.length <= HEAD_CHARS → sub-head guard → whole (this guard already exists for whole files — apply it to the SLICE length); else page the slice: head = headSlice(slice), headLines = headCompleteLineCount(head), resumeLine = startLine + headLines (FILE coordinates so the model's read continues at the correct absolute line), push formatTextFileBlock(abs, head) + formatPagedDirectiveBlock(abs, slice.length, resumeLine, headLines), detail {path, kind:'paged', chars: slice.length, range: `:${resumeLine}-`, pagedHeadLines: headLines, directive: extractDirectiveInner(directiveBlock)}, state.paged++, subtract(Math.ceil(HEAD_CHARS/4)). Mock nothing — pure function of state; drive budgets in tests via ctx.getContextUsage fixtures (PAGED_FIX L415, TINY_FIX L1127). Because injectMarkdown re-slices inside emitText, markdown ranged tokens get this fix automatically — assert one markdown ranged case under a tight budget.
4. OUTPUT: emitText range branch runs the §5.5 decision; paged slices bump state.paged (surfacing in the existing mode-aware notify). Behavior with remaining===null must be byte-identical to today so LINE-1…LINE-6 stay green. Write the failing test first (tight budget + #@huge.log:1-999999 → kind:'paged', head + directive with file-coordinate offset) — this becomes formal gate LINE-8 in P1.M2.T1.S2; consume nothing new, expose no new exports.
5. DOCS: Mode A — replace the L1304 branch comment with the new rule (slice runs the same budget decision as a whole file). The full emitText JSDoc rewrite is owned by P1.M1.T1.S3; do not duplicate it here.

subtasks.title: LR-5: clamp the displayed range to the delivered range
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: code_map.md §emitText L1306 — rangeSuffix is built from the REQUESTED startLine/endLine, so :2-100000 on a 5-line file displays 'read a.ts:2-100000' while delivering lines 2–5. Clamping detection is free from the slice (spec §6 LR-5): delivered last line = startLine + (newlines in slice); the slice contains deliveredLineCount−1 newlines. Canonical form (LR-7, already pinned): delivered start === delivered end → ':N' (never ':N-N').
2. INPUT: The rewritten range branch from P1.M1.T1.S1 (slice already computed there).
3. LOGIC: Build rangeSuffix from the DELIVERED range, not the requested one, on the whole-slice path: deliveredEnd = startLine + (slice.match(/\n/g)?.length ?? 0); rangeSuffix = startLine === deliveredEnd ? `:${startLine}` : `:${startLine}-${deliveredEnd}`; FileDetail.range = rangeSuffix. On the paged-slice path (S1) detail.range remains the resume directive `:${resumeLine}-`. Mock nothing. Existing LINE-1…6 fixtures use in-file ranges (:3, :2-3) so their expectations are unchanged — run them to confirm.
4. OUTPUT: FileDetail.range and the collapsed read line show ':2-5' for '#@a.ts:2-100000' on a 5-line file (display and delivery agree). Failing test first — this becomes formal gate LINE-12 in P1.M2.T1.S2. No interface changes.
5. DOCS: Mode A — update any JSDoc/comment on emitText/FileDetail that describes range as the 'requested' range to say 'delivered (clamped) range; :<resumeLine>- on the paged path'. Rides with the work.

tasks.title: LR-2 claim-by-classification + LR-3/LR-4 failure feedback
tasks.description: R2: images/binaries claim the bare abs so identical bytes are never attached twice. R3: malformed ranges (:0, :5-3) that resolve to no file fire a hasUI-guarded warning notify instead of vanishing. subtasks.title: LR-2: images/binaries claim the bare abs (no duplicate bytes)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: code_map.md §injectFile — the claim claimKey(abs, startLine, endLine) happens at L1239–1240 BEFORE classification; the three non-text branches are F5 empty-image (L1247–1253), F3 real-image (L1255–1271, magic-number sniff + resize + state.images.push), binary note (L1275–1281). Today '#@pic.png #@pic.png:3' claims abs and abs:3 → the same image attached twice. Spec §3 LR-2 implementation shape: keep the pre-read ranged claim (recursion-readiness, unchanged), then once classified image/binary the EFFECTIVE claim is the bare abs; text/markdown keep claiming abs:N / abs:N-M (distinct ranges are distinct deliveries).
2. INPUT: injectFile(abs, state, ctx, startLine?, endLine?) with state.injectedSet; claimKey (L192–196) already canonicalizes :N ≡ :N-N.
3. LOGIC: In EACH of the three branches (F5, F3, binary), before emitting: if state.injectedSet.has(abs) → duplicate → emit NOTHING, do not bump state.count, leave the token verbatim and return false (nothing emitted); otherwise add the bare abs key (the ranged key may remain alongside harmlessly or be normalized/deleted — spec allows both; pick one and note it in the JSDoc). scanTokens' localSeen dedups only same-key scans, so the ranged record still reaches injectFile and must be turned away there. Both token orders must dedup ('#@pic.png #@pic.png:3' AND '#@pic.png:3 #@pic.png'). Mock nothing (real fixture images already exist in the test suite — reuse the pic.png fixture used by budget tests ~L1563+).
4. OUTPUT: exactly one state.images entry for the png pair; exactly one binary note for a binary twin pair; state.count bumped once per actually-delivered file. Failing tests first for both orders and both kinds — formalized as LINE-9 in P1.M2.T1.S1. LINE-1…6 (text/markdown claims) unchanged.
5. DOCS: Mode A — JSDoc on injectFile claim semantics: 'claim ⟺ delivered; images/binaries claim the bare abs — a range is meaningless identity for them'. Rides with the work.

subtasks.title: LR-3: malformed-range tokens warn instead of vanishing
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: code_map.md — splitLineRange (L170–177) returns {path: token} for invalid suffixes (:0, :5-3), indistinguishable from 'no suffix'; scanTokens (L1144–1180, EXPORTED, unit-tested by LINE-5 at test L3008+) then drops the unresolvable token silently. CRITICAL: scanTokens has NO ctx parameter, so the notify CANNOT fire inside it — signal out and fire from the ctx-holding caller processTokenStream (L1195+), mirroring the SPA-fallback pattern `if (ctx.hasUI) ctx.ui?.notify(…, 'info')` at L956 (but type 'warning' here).
2. INPUT: cleaned token (after §4.3 trailing-punct trim) inside scanTokens; resolveImportPath results (exact-first: a literal file named 'a.ts:10' WINS whole — must never notify).
3. LOGIC: (a) splitLineRange gains an invalid marker (e.g. invalid?: true when the regex /:(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?$/ matched but validation failed — start<1 or end<start) while valid- and no-suffix return shapes stay byte-identical; update LINE-4's two invalid-case unit expectations accordingly (they currently assert {path:'a.ts:0'} raw-fallback). (b) scanTokens surfaces invalid-range tokens that fail BOTH exact and stripped resolution (e.g. a record {path: rawToken, invalidRange: true} or a parallel return) WITHOUT breaking the exported contract/LINE-5. (c) processTokenStream: for such records fire `if (ctx.hasUI) ctx.ui?.notify(\`#@a.ts:0 — not injected (range must be :N or :N-M, M ≥ N ≥ 1)\`, 'warning')` (message shows the token as typed) and skip injection — token stays verbatim. Must NOT fire for: tokens with no range-looking suffix, valid ranges that resolve, or invalid-suffix tokens whose literal file EXISTS (exact-path-wins). Note: markdown-import scans call scanTokens directly from injectMarkdown — threading the notify there is optional (top-level prompt path is REQUIRED and is what LINE-10 tests); if threaded, no duplicate notifies per token.
4. OUTPUT: LINE-10 behavior — injected:0, prompt verbatim, warning notify fired (asserted via the spy ctx {hasUI:true, ui:{notify:(m,t)=>notes.push({m,t})}} from url-injection.test.mjs L703, passed to injectFiles whose ctx param is 3rd — see L1661). Failing test first.
5. DOCS: Mode A — JSDoc on splitLineRange documenting the invalid marker, and the notify string documented at the firing site. Rides with the work.

subtasks.title: LR-4: past-EOF start is a failed token (no empty block, claim revoked, notify)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: code_map.md — sliceLines (L183–189) returns '' iff startLine > lineCount (trailing-newline 'wc -l' semantics; a 0-byte file has 0 lines, so '#@empty.txt:1' is also past-EOF). Today emitText pushes an EMPTY <file> block, injectFile bumps count (L1284), and the claim stays poisoned. The revoke pattern to copy: injectFile's catch at L1287 (state.injectedSet.delete(key), claim ⟺ delivered, §12.5). Notify pattern: hasUI-guarded ctx.ui?.notify(…, 'warning') per L956. Depends on T1.S1 because it modifies the same rewritten range branch.
2. INPUT: slice/line-count data from S1's range branch; claimKey(abs, startLine, endLine) as the key to revoke; ctx threaded into injectFile already.
3. LOGIC: PRD R3 leaves the seam open — implementer's choice between (a) emitText signals failure upward (e.g. returns boolean) so injectFile skips count++ and un-claims, or (b) injectFile's text branch AND injectMarkdown's ranged path pre-check startLine > lineCount(content) before emission. Whichever seam, the CONTRACT is: empty delivered slice ⟹ NO block, NO detail, NO count bump, claim REVOKED (state.injectedSet.delete(claimKey(abs, startLine, endLine)) so a repeat valid token of the same file still injects), token verbatim, and hasUI-guarded warning notify `#@a.ts:99 — not injected (file has 5 lines)` (line count uses the same trailing-newline semantics; token shown as typed). MUST cover BOTH call paths: direct text branch (injectFile L1282) and markdown (injectMarkdown L1395+ → emitText L1412) — a ranged markdown token past EOF must also fail, not deliver an empty block. A clamped END still delivers (clamping is recovery, not failure — do not fail :2-100000). Mock nothing.
4. OUTPUT: LINE-11 behavior — no block with empty body, injected:0, claim released (a subsequent '#@a.ts:1' in the SAME prompt still injects — scanTokens ran before the claim, so ordering matters: verify the revoke happens before later tokens process or that processTokenStream's belt-and-suspenders re-check tolerates it), notify fired. Failing test first; LINE-1…6 green.
5. DOCS: Mode A — JSDoc on the chosen seam (injectFile and/or emitText) stating 'empty delivered slice ⟹ failed token: verbatim + revoked claim + warning notify (mirrors the read tool, which errors past EOF)'. Rides with the work.
